reason: Conversation 1 asked for the brand, display and beep pattern, then recognised a door-ajar temperature alarm. It confirmed that the -9 reading and slow drop mean normal recovery, and it gave useful food-safety advice on thawed items such as ice cream. Its weaknesses are minor: it quotes Fahrenheit figures and suggests Super Freeze and a brief power cycle that are not needed. Conversation 2 opens with 'switch it off and unplug it', which is unnecessary and counterproductive for a freezer full of food. It never asks what the display shows, never mentions the bell/alarm-off button that silences the beep, and gives little food-safety guidance. Its closing advice to wait and recheck is sound but thin.
